The main takeaway from our work is that
we have demonstrated that the thyroid gland is a key organ that regulates folate metabolism and the synthesis of folates.

we have shown that the thyroid gland is a key player in the regulation of folate metabolism and that thyroid hormones have a profound effect on the folate coenzymatic pool, particularly the formylated derivatives of tetrahydropyrrole.
